tokens.name: abyss
tokens.usage: The page ground. Every screen starts here; glass, glows and the grid sit on top of it.

tokens.name: midnight
tokens.usage: Second ground: section bands, the far stop of the ambient backdrop, tooltips over glass.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Opaque raised surface: the fallback for glass where backdrop blur is unavailable, menus, the FloatButton tooltip.

tokens.name: deep-raised
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of an opaque surface; the night slab on the cover. All three inks read on it (ink-faint at 5.3:1).

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Default glass fill for GlassPanel, VitalTile and NavBar. Always paired with the glass-blur backdrop and a glass-edge border.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Denser glass for small floating things (FloatButton, glass Button, caption chips) and nested panels.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Decorative 1px rim on glass. It does not meet 3:1; never rely on it alone to show a control's boundary.

tokens.name: glass-edge-strong
tokens.usage: Rim of floating controls (FloatButton, glass Button). Pair with a fill change so the control stays findable.

tokens.name: sheen
tokens.usage: Top-light gradient stop on glass, the matte highlight along the upper edge.

tokens.name: control-edge
tokens.usage: Border of inputs and other controls whose boundary must be seen: at least 3:1 on abyss, deep and every glass fill.

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: The 48px monitor grid behind heroes and telemetry. Decoration only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headlines, on abyss, midnight, deep and every glass fill (at least 10:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, body copy under headlines, nav links at rest; on abyss, midnight, deep and glass (at least 6:1).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Units, captions, timestamps, telemetry labels; on abyss, midnight, deep, deep-raised and glass, including glass over a glow (at least 4.7:1).

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: The action colour: primary buttons, links, focus, the hologram, active nav. As text on every ground (at least 7:1). Text on a cyan fill is on-accent.

tokens.name: cyan-bright
tokens.usage: Hover of cyan fills and cyan text; highlights inside the hologram.

tokens.name: cyan-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind cyan text and icons: info pills, ghost-button hover, icon wells.

tokens.name: cyan-glow
tokens.usage: Colour of the cyan halo in glow-cyan and the hologram's drop shadow. Light, never a fill.

tokens.name: emerald
tokens.usage: The life colour: vitals in range, live presence, ECG traces, the vital button. As text on every ground (at least 7.9:1). Text on an emerald fill is on-accent.

tokens.name: emerald-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind emerald text: the stable and live pills, vital icon wells.

tokens.name: emerald-glow
tokens.usage: Colour of the emerald halo in glow-emerald.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on cyan, cyan-bright, emerald, amber and alert fills (at least 7.7:1).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Watch: a reading drifting out of range, a pending request. As text on every ground and on amber-soft. Always with a word and the eye glyph.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind amber text in the watch pill.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Critical only. The critical pill is a solid alert fill with on-accent text, so it differs from stable by weight and glyph, not hue alone. As text, on every ground (at least 4.6:1).

tokens.name: alert-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind alert text in an inline error or an invalid Field hint.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links. An alias of cyan, so links follow the action colour.

families.sans: "Plex Latin", "Plex Arabic", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Tahoma, sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Tight, heavy, negative tracking. One display size per screen.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The hero headline only, once per page.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Section openers and the headline on narrow screens.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Page titles inside the app, large panel titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and panel titles, the hologram caption name.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Plex Latin and Plex Arabic share one stack, so mixed Arabic and English lines set in one family.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Specialists, diagnostics and your records in one continuous space.
styles.usage: Hero and section lead paragraphs, in ink-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your cardiologist can join from the clinic or from home.

styles.name: body-ar
styles.sample: رعاية لا تنام، وبياناتك لا تغادر جهازك.
styles.usage: Arabic prose. One pixel larger and much taller than body, because Arabic letterforms carry more vertical detail.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, nav links, field labels, pill text.

groups.name: Telemetry
groups.note: Every number a clinician might compare is set in JetBrains Mono so digits line up.

styles.name: metric-xl
styles.usage: The one reading a VitalTile is about.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above readings and above hero headlines, in ink-faint or cyan.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: ICD-10-AM codes, identifiers, anything copied into a claim.

spacing.note: 4px base. Layout gutters are space-16 at 1440px and space-6 on phones.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph to text inside pills; tight icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside buttons; between stacked pills.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a label and its control; FloatButton tooltip offset.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Small panel padding; gap between Buttons.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button side padding at md.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Default panel padding; phone page gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large panel padding; gap between telemetry widgets.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between a headline and its lead paragraph group.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: The monitor grid pitch; between hero blocks.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter at 1280 to 1440px.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

radius.note: Everything floats, so everything is rounded. Controls are pills; containers step up with size.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Icon wells inside small chips, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Icon wells in VitalTile, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Fields, small glass cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: GlassPanel and VitalTile.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero stages and full-width glass bands.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, pills, NavBar, FloatButton, search fields.

shadow.note: Depth comes from darkness under glass and light around actions. Glows are for things you can press or that are alive, never for static text.

tokens.name: elev-glass
tokens.usage: Resting glass panels: a long soft drop plus a one-pixel top light.

tokens.name: elev-float
tokens.usage: Floating controls: FloatButton, NavBar, caption chips.

tokens.name: glow-cyan
tokens.usage: Primary Button, hovered FloatButton, a GlassPanel with glow cyan.

tokens.name: glow-emerald
tokens.usage: Vital Button, the live pill, a GlassPanel with glow emerald.

tokens.name: glow-alert
tokens.usage: The critical pill and the emergency FloatButton. Nothing else.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px abyss gap then 2px of solid cyan (at least 7:1 on every ground).

backdrop.note: Backdrop filters for glass. Where backdrop-filter is unsupported, glass falls back to a deep fill.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: GlassPanel, VitalTile, NavBar.

tokens.name: glass-blur-sm
tokens.usage: Small floating controls: FloatButton, glass Button, caption chips.

duration.note: Motion breathes, then stops. Under prefers-reduced-motion every loop halts and transitions drop to instant.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Press and hover lift.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Colour, border and glow changes.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Panels arriving, gauges filling.

tokens.name: dur-ambient
tokens.usage: One turn of the hologram's orbit rings.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that arrives or lifts.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Loops: the hologram sweep, pulsing dots.
